admission.justification: Proved by unit tests in tests/unit/test_site_compiler.py and required for the Phase 4 compiler family guarantee; prevents raw directive leaks, HTML attribute breakage, corrupted code or math blocks and broken script-off glossary fallbacks.

applicability: Pure Markdown transformation functions in src/rh_pipeline/site/markdown_transforms.py compiling explainer directives, three-level zoom sections and static page glossaries.
conditions: expand_concept_directives skips fenced code, inline code and $...$/$$...$$ math, splits {{concept:slug|prose}} on the first pipe, HTML-escapes all emitted Vue attributes and raises SiteDirectiveError on malformed or unknown directives.
split_zoom_levels wraps ordered Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 headings outside fenced code in <ZoomTabs> slots, and render_page_glossary validates slugs and emits an ordered static <dl> fallback.
exclusions: Pages lacking all three ordered Level 1/2/3 headings are returned unmodified by split_zoom_levels; empty reference lists return an empty string from render_page_glossary.
statement: expand_concept_directives expands {{concept:slug|inline prose}} into <ConceptReveal> and {{term:slug[|display]}} into <ConceptHover> with HTML-escaped attributes, preserves fenced code, inline code, and LaTeX math untouched, and fails closed with SiteDirectiveError on malformed or unknown directives.
title: Fail-closed concept directive expansion, ZoomTabs and page glossary transforms
